findings.evidence: `Observable/Basic.lean:235-236` `def IsInfraredSafe (O : Multiset V → X) : Prop := ∀ s : Multiset V, Tendsto (fun p : V => O (p ::ₘ s)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (O s))` — line 479's conclusion is exactly this condition at `s = a ::ₘ t`, and `Basic.lean:268-285` (`IsInfraredSafe.add/.sub/.mul`) plus `IsIRCSafe` (`Basic.lean:296-300`) all consume `IsInfraredSafe`, not a raw `Tendsto`. The empty state genuinely needs the extra hypothesis `h0`, which is why it must be a parameter rather than derived.
findings.fix: Add the bridge, keeping the pointwise lemma: `theorem RecombinationScheme.isInfraredSafe_of_isUnital [TopologicalSpace V] [TopologicalSpace X] {J : Multiset V → X} (hR : R.IsUnital) (hRc : ∀ a : V, ContinuousAt (R.merge a) 0) (hJc : ∀ (a : V) (t : Multiset V), ContinuousAt (fun v : V => J (v ::ₘ t)) a) (hJ : ∀ (a : V) (t : Multiset V), ∀ᶠ p : V in 𝓝 0, J (p ::ₘ a ::ₘ t) = J (R.merge a p ::ₘ t)) (h0 : Tendsto (fun p : V => J (p ::ₘ 0)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (J 0))) : IsInfraredSafe J`, proved by `Multiset.induction`-style case split on `s = 0` (use `h0`) versus `s = a ::ₘ t` (use `tendsto_cons_of_merge_zero (hR.merge_zero a) ...`). Instantiate it for `eScheme` via `isUnital_eScheme` and `(continuous_eScheme_merge a).continuousAt`.
findings.issue: The collinear side lands the canonical predicate (`IsCollinearExact.isCollinearSafe : IsCollinearSafe J`, line 454), but the infrared side delivers only a pointwise `Tendsto` at one state `a ::ₘ t`. No lemma concludes `IsInfraredSafe J`, so a consumer cannot use `IsInfraredSafe.add/.map/.map₂` or build `IsIRCSafe` without redoing the `∀ s` case split and the whole merge-continuity argument itself.

summary: The surface is minimal, bodies are unexposed, and the collinear-exactness API is complete and annotated. The one gap is that the infrared result stops at a bare `Tendsto` and never reaches `IsInfraredSafe`, the canonical predicate of the file it imports, so it cannot be fed to the infrared algebra in `Observable/Basic.lean`.
